messages:
Maya: Heads-up: PR #482 updates the fallback behavior section for 429s + timeouts. Need SDK snippet updated to show retry-with-backoff + context trimming. cc @liam @ellen
Liam: On it. Which SDK snippet is broken?
Maya: The Python snippet in "Error handling" shows a naive retry loop, doesn't trim context. Also the SDK now has `client.retry_with_backoff()` helper — we should prefer that.
Ellen: I can update the JS/TS snippets. For Python, @liam want me to do a quick patch? Also where to link the migration guide?
Maya: Link to /docs/guides/fallbacks-migration -> currently 404. Need link fix too.
Liam: I'll open a tiny redirect PR in docs site. Ellen — do you want me to drop the helper into the snippet like:
```python
with client.retry_with_backoff(max_retries=3):
    resp = client.generate(model="open-large", input=prompt)
```
Ellen: That helper name landed in 2.1.0 — perfect. Also suggest showing context trimming inline: `prompt = prompt[-(max_tokens*3):]` and mention `Retry-After` support.
Maya: We should also add a short note about 429 meaning "request throttled; retry later" and advise reading `Retry-After` header and honoring it if present.
deploy-bot: Deploy status: docs site build queued for PR #482 — 2 jobs.
Liam: Redirect PR opened (docs-site#219). Ping @Maya for review.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll review in 30m. Ellen can you paste JS examples in PR comments so review has context?
Ellen: Done — pasted snippet + added inline note about `client.options.max_context` trimming and a tiny unit test showing trimmed prompt length.
Maya: Thanks. After merge, can someone file a follow-up to add a Console trace sample showing fallback routing? Ticket created: DOCS-298
Liam: I'll add it to the backlog and tag product for prioritization.
Maya: Ok merging after CI green. If you see >5% increase in 429s after rollout, roll back and alert #eng-releases.
Ellen: Noted. I'll watch the perf dashboard for 24h and report.
Maya: Awesome — appreciate the quick turn on this.
